scope.source_selection_caveat: All successfully processed wavelength blocks in the supplied campaign selected post-QA analog single-channel fallback. This campaign therefore does not validate glued or photon-counting high-column behavior.
scope.lineage_caveat: These products predate the later block-local KFS input-rejection robustness fix. Historical wavelength-fatal ref_idx failures remain evidence of old behavior, not current-head expected behavior.
scope.label_caveat: Atmospheric labels are user-supplied observational annotations, not independent aerosol/cloud ground truth.

cross_case_findings.clean_does_not_imply_high_column_support: Clean-labelled/visually unobstructed cases range from robust near-10-km support (20250628/29) to fragile paths (20250521 and 20250716 afternoon).
cross_case_findings.high_cloud_candidate_reentry: 20250509sant contains a strong layer near 14.36-14.37 km. All-block accepted candidates form a lower connected run ending near 12.1-12.3 km, then disconnected accepted islands reappear above about 15.3 km. Acceptance plus persistence alone cannot certify a molecular boundary.
cross_case_findings.candidate_topology: The first contiguous all-block accepted run is useful as a threshold-free topology diagnostic, but it is not authorized as a productive boundary rule because isolated noisy gaps and strict all-block persistence can truncate otherwise informative regions.
cross_case_findings.sequence_20250509_10: Candidate topology changes materially from the high-cloud night to the adjacent record: disconnected high-altitude re-entry on 20250509 versus a single all-block connected run ending near 9.3-9.4 km on 20250510.
cross_case_findings.sequence_20250628_29: Both adjacent night records support nominal near-10-km paths in all blocks; first connected ceilings are about 12.15/13.10 km on 20250628 and 11.68/12.14 km on 20250629 for 355/532 nm.
cross_case_findings.sequence_20250716: The morning record has only one block and cannot establish temporal persistence. The later eight-block record is much more fragile around 10 km.
cross_case_findings.scc_semantics: 20250629sant_scc.nc is a MILGRAU Level-0 SCC-compatible raw input, not an SCC/ELDA optical retrieval output, so it is not an external optical comparison.
cross_case_findings.lineage_20251107: The campaign 20251107 Level-1 SHA differs from the previously active baseline; it is not a pure Level-2 code-regression comparison.

empirical_vertical_dependence_20250629.method: Block-demeaned Level-1 range-corrected-signal residuals divided by supplied per-profile uncertainty, using 20-min floor blocks and the existing vertical_noise_autocorrelation R&D semantics.
empirical_vertical_dependence_20250629.interpretation: In this one clean-night analog case, 5-20 km vertical dependence is much closer to the independent limit than the fully correlated limit: lag-1 correlation is about 0.10-0.13 and most longer-lag correlations are only a few percent. The implied 60/120 m SNR gains remain below sqrt(8)/sqrt(16). Residual atmospheric variability can contribute, so this is not a station-wide covariance law.

decision: Keep productive schema v3 / method v4 unchanged. Candidate topology, empirical covariance and aggregation remain R&D diagnostics. No high-column boundary, cloud veto, continuity gate, aggregation width or method-v5 promotion is authorized from this campaign alone.
next_gate: Run 60/120 m aggregation and lower-column-preservation experiments across favorable and unfavorable campaign cases under explicit dependence assumptions; also obtain at least one glued or photon-counting-dominant real case before a productive high-column backbone decision.
